description: Source code for handling actions in a rule-based system, including parsing XML definitions, managing action parameters, dependencies, and loading action lists from files.

methods.name: icrule_action_list_load
methods.description: Loads action definitions from an XML file into a hash map.

methods.name: icrule_action_list_release
methods.description: Releases all resources associated with the action list hash map.

methods.name: icrule_get_action_list_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where action list files are stored.

methods.name: icrule_set_action_list_dir
methods.description: Sets the directory path for action list files.

methods.name: icrule_update_message_attachment
methods.description: Updates message actions with attachment parameters based on linked list of actions.

methods.name: icrule_free_action
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an action object.

methods.name: icrule_free_parameter
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an action parameter.

methods.name: icrule_parse_action
methods.description: Parses an XML node to create an action object and add it to the actions list.
